cytat: Raise to 3bb+1bb per limper when playing online, and 4bb+1bb per limper when playing live.
Base open size (3bb) + 1 big blind per limper
Never min-raise a limped pot. A raise to 2bb over a 1bb limp gives every limper 4-to-1 odds to call. At those prices, even 72o starts becoming a call.
over-sizing to 10-12bb against a single limper
The BB ISO is the least common and least profitable spot. You check your option or raise for value/semi-bluff.
A 5-6bb raise over a 1bb limp is an example, not a universal solver prescription.
